attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(1821 - 1893)». The corpus holds six folders whose names fold onto this one — Paisios the Athonite, Paisius of Neamț, Paisius the Great, Paisie of Sihăstria, Paisius of Sihăstria Putnei and the Paisius kept on 8 January — and none of them is a nineteenth-century fool for Christ of the Kyiv Lavra. The page prints no couplet and no hymn.
